posts.text: That's a wrap on Day 1 of #WebSummit 2026 🇵🇹

"In Europe, it's very important for our citizens that they can trust these technologies." 🇪🇺

Henna Virkkunen of the European Commission spoke at #WebSummit about balancing innovation with the protection of citizens.

Did you know AI is now helping us skip animal trials in medicine? 🧬

Richard Socher took the #WebSummit stage to share how Parallel Bio’s AI-generated organoids have been FDA-approved to test drug toxicity without using animals. It's a beautiful example of how AI can save lives.

The numbers are in for #WebSummit 2026 🥳

Web Summit opened on Monday, November 9, drawing 70,003 attendees, 3,052 exhibiting companies, and 1,943 investors.

Will AI agents become your next target audience? 🤖💼

At #WebSummit, Anton Osika of Lovable breaks down how AI agents will soon make buying decisions for their "human overlords," and why human storytelling will still be the key to making a sale.
Olá, Lisboa 🇵🇹 Welcome to day one of #WebSummit!

#WebSummit is officially live! 🇵🇹

See you all tomorrow for Day 1.

"Difference and diversity is the mother of innovation."

Speaking on stage at #WebSummit, Mayor of Lisbon Carlos Moedas reminds us that the solution to our biggest challenges often comes from connecting with those who see the world completely differently.

Is the new Silicon Valley in the Global East? 🤔 

Web Summit CEO & Founder Paddy Cosgrave takes the stage at #WebSummit to share why the next generation of superstars in AI, energy, and robotics are coming out of China, not California.
